title: Stroked ellipse can't be picked/dragged at its centre — fragments into ~25 merge fill-loops, centre face pickAt returns null
description: FIXED (task 1334). Post-1332 re-measure: stroked oval folds CLEAN on first commit (1 face); the bug appears on REBUILD of the live planar map (livePlanarShape) from the committed shape. Read-back emitted the stroked fill boundary as ~12 separate stroke fragments + sub-twip stubs; on rebuild the fill loop and those fragments are the SAME geometry split differently (coincident curves), and intersectCurveCurve had NO coincidence case -> flooded ~14.6k half-edges -> interior shattered -> locateFace/pickAt at centre null. Fix (3 curve-preserving layers): (1) intersect.ts coincidentOverlap reports overlap-interval endpoints not a flood; (2) arrangement.ts drops zero-span split pieces (lines AND curves); (3) query.ts emits a uniformly-stroked fill loop as ONE combined fill+stroke path + drops sub-twip stubs. Now identical to stroke-free oval: 1 bounded fill face, centre->fill face, splitOnMove extracts it. VERIFIED: core 5485 pass (3 pre-existing missing-fixture flash8-empty.fla ENOENT only), swf 1466, authoring-ui 1022; 8 merge oracles diff=0/220000; regression test planar-subselection.test.ts 'task 1334'; docs/36 3.0h.
